get.description:
Get a list of Users in the Joomla site.

GET never returns passwords. The create controller copies a supplied password into confirmation. PATCH preserves omitted passwords and has special handling for omitted group memberships. Filters such as registrationDateStart and lastVisitDateEnd take RFC3339 date-time values, unlike many administrator calendar writes. User plugins and custom fields can extend the form. Grant integrations only the group-management permissions they need.

Managing user groups and creating, editing or deleting viewing access levels requires core.admin on com_users. A general edit permission is insufficient for these operations. Access-level rules is an ID array for POST and a JSON-encoded array string for PATCH; supplying an array to PATCH raises TypeError. The base edit check requires core.manage and record core.edit, or core.edit.own with a matching owner; component overrides take precedence. Omitted SERVER_UTC/USER_UTC calendar values are restored from the stored UTC values after validation, avoiding a second timezone conversion.

BearerAuth.description: Joomla API token of a user, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Users get their token on the Joomla API Token tab of their profile. The plugins "API Authentication - Web Services Joomla Token" and "User - Joomla API Token" must be enabled.

JoomlaToken.name: X-Joomla-Token
JoomlaToken.description: The same API token in the `X-Joomla-Token` header. Joomla tries to extract a Bearer token first and reads this header when the extracted token is empty. A non-empty Bearer token takes precedence even when authentication fails.

BasicAuth.description: Username and password of a user. Only works when the plugin "API Authentication - Web Services Basic Auth" is enabled, which it is not by default.

JUpdateToken.name: X-JUpdate-Token
JUpdateToken.description: Update token of the Joomla Automated Updates service, set in the options of Joomla Update. Only used by the `/v1/joomlaupdate` endpoints.
